title: Using `VIEW_INDEX` in shader causes crash with Vulkan mobile renderer
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.5.dev.custom_build [d59994688]

### System information

Godot v4.5.dev (d59994688) - Pop!_OS 22.04 LTS on X11 - X11 display driver, Single-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Ti - AMD Ryzen 9 7950X 16-Core Processor (32 threads)

### Issue description

When using the Vulkan mobile renderer, if you have a shader that accesses `VIEW_INDEX`, then Godot will crash.

**I've bisected the issue to PR https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/102552**

Before crashing, I get these errors printed:

```
ERROR: code: [shader code]
   at: compile_stages (servers/rendering/renderer_rd/shader_rd.cpp:990)
ERROR: Condition "variant_stages.is_empty()" is true.
   at: _compile_variant (servers/rendering/renderer_rd/shader_rd.cpp:312)
```

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a `MeshInstance3D` with a `BoxMesh` shape
2. Add a new `ShaderMaterial` in its "Surface Material Override"
3. Add a new `Shader` which uses `VIEW_INDEX` at all
4. It doesn't matter if the multiview shaders are enabled or not (they are enabled in my MRP)

Here's an example shader:

```
shader_type spatial;

uniform vec3 albedo_left : source_color;
uniform vec3 albedo_right : source_color;

void fragment() {
	ALBEDO = int(VIEW_INDEX) == int(0) ? albedo_left : albedo_right;
}
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

This MRP will crash as soon as you open it in the editor: 

[variant-stages-empty-mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20619123/variant-stages-empty-mrp.zip)
